mapper.select: select wpc.id, wpc.code, wpc.sort_order, wpc.is_show, wpci.locale, wpci.name, wpci.description, wpci.image_attachment_id from website_product_category wpc join website_product_category_i18n wpci on wpci.website_product_category_id = wpc.id where wpci.locale = #{locale} and wpc.is_deleted = false and wpci.is_deleted = false order by wpc.sort_order asc, wpc.id asc
